subject: Coordinating architecture deep-dive for Hosted runtime & SDKs
messages:
From: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@acmehealth.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya@acmehealth.com>
Date: 2027-03-20T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: Hosted runtime / SDK deep-dive (big-picture + integration)

Sean —

Thanks for taking this forward. We’d like a focused architecture deep-dive with your team to make sure our integration plan covers SDK streaming, function/tool calling, and runtime constraints (token limits, latency SLOs, KV cache behavior). We’re planning a production pilot in Q3 and need to validate patterns for:

- SDK choices and streaming best practices for low-latency UIs
- How Redwood handles tool/function calls and structured outputs
- Fallbacks when quantized variants or regional routing are used
- Observability hooks we can integrate into our tracing and cost dashboards

Attached is a short PDF of our current platform layout (current-architecture.pdf). Can your architects do a 60–75 minute session with our engineering leads? Our availability next week (PST):

- Tue 2027-03-23: 10:00–12:00 or 14:00–16:00
- Wed 2027-03-24: 09:00–11:00

If those don’t work we can push to the week of Mar 29. Also would like a suggested agenda and a list of any pre-reads/prework for our team.

Thanks,
Tom
CTO, Acme Health

Attachment: current-architecture.pdf (diagram, 4 pages)

From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya@acmehealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-03-22T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Hosted runtime / SDK deep-dive (big-picture + integration)

Tom —

Appreciate the detail and the diagram, that’s helpful. We can absolutely run a focused session. Proposed approach: 60–75 minutes, split 40 minutes of architecture walkthrough + 25–35 minutes of integration Q&A and next steps.

Suggested internal attendees: Ava (runtime/serving), Karthik (SDKs & streaming), Monica (operations & runbooks). Marissa, can you own the calendar coordination?

From our side we’re available Tue 3/23 14:00–15:15 PST or Wed 3/24 09:00–10:15 PST. If you prefer the following week, we also have Tue 3/30 10:00–11:15 PST.

Prework request (short):
- A short list of the integration use cases you plan to exercise in the pilot (1–3 bullets)
- Any non-negotiable latency/throughput SLOs
- Examples of tool calls you expect to implement

I’ll tentatively hold slots while we confirm.

Best,
Sean Gallagher
Lead Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
Cell: +1 (415) 555-0132

--
Reply options: Accept proposed time, propose alternate, or request recorded session and slide deck.

From: Priya Shah <priya@acmehealth.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@acmehealth.com>
Date: 2027-03-23T08:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Hosted runtime / SDK deep-dive (big-picture + integration)

Sean —

Thanks — 14:00 PST on Tue 3/23 would be ideal, but can we shift it 60 minutes later (15:00–16:15 PST)? That gives our East Coast folks time to join. Also please add our security lead (I’ll loop them after we confirm) — they want to hear the part about tool calling and data residency.

Agenda request: can you include a short segment (~10 mins) on SOC2/audit hooks and where Redwood surfaces logs and retention? I’ve attached a short prework questions doc (prework-questions.docx) listing our initial compliance/observability asks.

We’ll plan to join with:
- Tom Reynolds (CTO)
- Priya Shah (integration lead)
- Miguel Alvarez (platform engineer — may be on the call)

Thanks — once you confirm time we’ll send a calendar invite.

Priya
Head of Platform Integrations, Acme Health

Attachment: prework-questions.docx (9 questions)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Priya Shah <priya@acmehealth.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-03-25T14:55:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Hosted runtime / SDK deep-dive (big-picture + integration)

Priya / Tom —

15:00–16:15 PST on Tue 3/23 is fine from our side; I’ve updated the tentative hold and will convert to a confirmed invite once we have the final attendee list. For clarity on presenters and flow:

- 15:00–15:05 — quick intros and goals (Marissa)
- 15:05–15:30 — Runtime & serving overview (Ava) — coverage: batching, KV cache, quantization variants, routing policies
- 15:30–15:50 — SDKs + streaming patterns (Karthik) — coverage: client-side buffering, reconnects, token-windowing, streaming to UI
- 15:50–16:05 — Tool/function calling & structured output (Monica) — coverage: invocation patterns, safety checks, audit logs surfaced to customers
- 16:05–16:15 — Integration Q&A & next steps (all)

Prework that would help: the three pilot use cases you expect (bullet form) and any strict SLO numbers. We’ll prepare a 1–2 slide runbook summary (redwood-runbook-stub.md) and a short zoom recording permission note.

We plan to record the session and share slides. If that’s not acceptable for compliance, let us know and we’ll disable recording.

Marissa
Senior Solutions Manager, Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood-runbook-stub.md

From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Priya Shah <priya@acmehealth.com>, Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-03-29T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Confirmed: Hosted runtime & SDK deep-dive — Tue Mar 23, 15:00 PST (recorded)

Team —

Thanks for the coordination. Confirming the session as follows:

When: Tue 2027-03-23, 15:00–16:15 PST (we will record; recording will be stored for 90 days)
Where: Zoom — https://zoom.us/j/999-555-1212?pwd=arch-zoom-link
Agenda: (as below, concise)
- Intros & goals (5m)
- Runtime/serving internals (Ava) — batching & KV cache behavior, quantization tradeoffs, routing/fallback policies (25m)
- SDK & streaming best practices (Karthik) — reconnect/backpressure, chunked tokens to UI, large response handling (20m)
- Tool/function calling & audit trail (Monica) — structured outputs, invocation patterns, logs surfaced to customer systems (15m)
- Q&A & next steps (10m)

Prework received: current-architecture.pdf and prework-questions.docx — thanks. If you can also send the three pilot use cases and any strict SLO numbers by EOD Mon 2027-03-29 that gives the presenters time to tailor examples.

HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/67890 (ACME-2027-08-RI)

If anything changes to attendees or compliance constraints, flag it to Marissa. Looking forward to the session.

Best,
Sean Gallagher
Lead Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0132
